''See also: [[Blue Titan Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The [[Blue Divine Titan]] is a massive, building-sized mechanical entity characterized by its slender frame and bright blue plating. Its armor is uniquely designed to resemble an organic insect carapace rather than standard powered suits. This advanced piece of [[Aethertech]] is specifically tuned for [[water elementalism]], though it can function with other forms of magic. The machine features a helmet shaped like a hood and is used in tandem with a large staff. In combat, the [[Titan]] can utilize a [[resonance]] cannon, which activates magic circle{{!}}magic circles and projectors to surround the machine in blue light. While it is one of several [[Divine Titans]], including [[Red]], White, Yellow, and Green models, the Blue [[Titan]] has been described as being in a state of disrepair, appearing like a collection of scrap metal.}}

== The Knight ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Originally intended to serve as a countermeasure against the magic of the [[D’Niss]], the Blue [[Titan]] is a mech equipped with innate magic resistance. Although the narrator has previously operated this machine during various missions, they had once dismissed its capabilities entirely. The vessel is specifically keyed to [[water elementalism]] and utilizes a staff designed for use with elemental magic. Furthermore, the machine functions through magic circle{{!}}magic circles that resonate with the [[Aether]].}}
